pseudo_depth_estimation.notes: Implemented using bbox vertical position and area

sparse_subset_decomposition.notes: Implemented by dividing detections into depth layers

two_stage_association.notes: Implemented with high-score then low-score matching

limitations: Pseudo-depth is estimated from 2D bounding box geometry only (no true depth sensor)
Kalman filter uses simplified constant-velocity model
Association uses greedy Hungarian-style matching rather than full optimization
No appearance features (Re-ID) used in either tracker
